\[
\sqrt{3}\sin 2x-\cos 2x = 2\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)
\]
so
\[
f(x)=2\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)-1.
\]
On \([0,\pi/2]\), \(2x-\frac{\pi}{6}\in[-\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{5\pi}{6}]\). The maximum of sine is \(1\), attained when \(2x-\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{\pi}{2}\), i.e. \(x=\frac{\pi}{3}\).

Thus the maximum value is
\[
2(1)-1=1.
\]

\boxed{1}
